what: A 100px white circle hanging at the top center of the section spreads into a large ellipse 300% wide (phone 700%) × 150% tall, from when the section’s top edge touches the bottom of the screen until its bottom edge passes the top, and becomes the section background — the arc edge at the top gradually flattens as the white panel covers the section (scrub 1, GSAP default curve). For sections that switch the background as they enter, like participation info or a pricing box

options.w · w-narrow · h: Fully spread size (% of section size), default 300% · 700% · 150%
options.start · end: ScrollTrigger start and end, default top bottom · bottom top
options.scrub: Seconds to lag behind scroll, default 1
options.[data-fx-part=circle]: Circle to spread (required) — a pattern (::before) may be laid inside

from.where: service.html .information (white grid circle behind the fee·how to join·add friend boxes)
